description: This file defines JavaScript classes and functions related to date/time handling and UI components within the SuiteCRM project, including SugarClass, SugarContainer, and SugarDateTime.

classes.name: SugarClass
classes.description: Base class providing initialization and inheritance methods.

classes.name: SugarContainer
classes.description: UI container class managing a root DOM element and widget loading.

classes.name: SugarDateTime
classes.description: Class handling date/time conversions, formatting, and parsing.

methods.name: SugarContainer.prototype.init
methods.description: Initializes SugarContainer with a root DOM element.

methods.name: SugarContainer.prototype.start
methods.description: Loads a widget into the container.

methods.name: SugarDateTime.prototype.init
methods.description: Initializes SugarDateTime with a root div.

methods.name: SugarDateTime.mysql2jsDateTime
methods.description: Converts MySQL date and time strings to JavaScript Date object.

methods.name: SugarDateTime.prototype.getFormattedDate
methods.description: Returns a formatted date string based on user preferences.

methods.name: SugarDateTime.prototype.getFormattedDOW
methods.description: Returns the day of week in formatted form.

methods.name: SugarDateTime.getAMPM
methods.description: Returns 'AM' or 'PM' based on the time.

methods.name: SugarDateTime.prototype.parseUTCDate
methods.description: Parses a UTC date string into a Date object.

methods.name: SugarDateTime.prototype.parseAdjustedDate
methods.description: Parses a date string with DST and GMT offset adjustments.

methods.name: SugarDateTime.prototype.getUTCHash
methods.description: Generates a UTC hash string from a Date object.
